meta.source: Bricks Design System — design_handoff_bricks package, June 2026
meta.description: Photographer field kit mobile app. Dark-first. Warm night, moon, and a single terracotta lifted from the mark.

theme_and_archetype.theme: Always Dark — field legibility at 6am, matte not glossy
theme_and_archetype.description: Night surface scale with moon text. Single terracotta accent. Hairline borders, 2px radius everywhere, zero drop shadows. Information density matters in the field.

font_loading.general_sans: Load via useFonts with keys 'GeneralSans-Regular' and 'GeneralSans-Medium' pointing to local OTF assets in /assets/fonts/.

rules: General Sans is the sole display/body font — do NOT use System, Helvetica, Outfit, Manrope, or Inter.
JetBrains Mono is used for all numbers, IDs, times, overline labels, and tabular data.
Overline/label style: font-mono, 10–10.5px, letter-spacing 0.14–0.18em, uppercase, color moonMute.
Display headings: font-display, weight 500, letter-spacing -1 to -1.2px, line-height 1.0–1.05.
Numbers in billing, job IDs, and timestamps must use font-mono for tabular alignment.

shape_and_elevation.border_radius: 2px everywhere — buttons, cards, badges, inputs, avatars. Pills (borderRadius: 999) only on type-selector chips.
shape_and_elevation.shadows: Zero drop shadows on any content surface. No elevation prop.
shape_and_elevation.borders: Hairline 1px borders at nightHair token (~8% moon on dark). Strong borders (nightHairS) for focus rings and selected states.

layout_and_spacing.surface: Mobile 390×844 (iPhone). Full-height SafeAreaView. Dark background night (#141210).
layout_and_spacing.content_padding: 24px horizontal screen padding. 16px inside cards and list cells.
layout_and_spacing.spacing_scale: Consistent use of 4/6/8/10/12/14/16/18/20/24/28/32/36/48 — do not introduce arbitrary values.

header.border: 1px nightHair bottom — flat, NO glassmorphism or backdrop-blur
header.contains: BricksWordmark at size=1 on auth screens; page title (General Sans 500 17px moon) + optional right action on interior screens

tab_bar.active: moon color, 2px brick top indicator, strokeWidth 1.75
tab_bar.label: mono 10px tracking-[0.12em] uppercase

components.job_card: bg nightSoft, border 1px nightHair, borderRadius 2px, padding 16px. Title: moon 500. Meta: moonMute mono 11px. Status badge top-right.
components.kpi_strip: Grid Borders dark: container bg nightHair, children bg night. Label: moonMute mono 10px uppercase. Value: moon mono 28px.

badge.style: padding 5px 9px, font-mono 10px tracking-[0.14em] uppercase, borderRadius 2px, no border

buttons.primary_brick: bg brick (#D2542B), color white, padding 14px 20px, fontSize 14px weight 500, borderRadius 2px, border none
buttons.primary_moon: bg moon, color night, same sizing
buttons.secondary: bg transparent, color moon, border 1px nightHairS, same sizing

components.chips_mobile: padding 9px 16px, borderRadius 999 (pill), active: bg moon color night, inactive: bg nightSoft border 1px nightHair
components.list_row: padding 16px 24px, fontSize 13px moonSoft, borderBottom 1px nightHair (except last row). Numbers right-aligned in mono.
components.upload_cell: bg nightSoft, border 1px nightHair, borderRadius 2px. Progress bar: brick color, 2px height.
components.avatar: borderRadius 2px, nightSoft background, initials in moonMute mono

icons.style: Custom hairline SVG set. strokeWidth 1.5 default (1.75 for active nav). strokeLinecap round, strokeLinejoin round. fill none. Color: moon (active), moonFaint (inactive).
icons.library_note: If using an external library, choose one that matches hairline weight at 1.5px stroke — e.g. lucide-react-native or @phosphor-icons/react-native at 'light' or 'regular' weight.

logo.mark_shape: The mark reads as a lowercase 'b' — NOT a pyramid or centered diamond. Two bricks stacked on the left form the vertical stem; one brick on the right at the bottom level forms the bowl.
logo.mark_layout: 3 bricks on a 24×24 viewBox with ~1.2px mortar gaps. stem-top (x=3,y=4,w=11,h=6.4,rx=0.8,opacity=0.82), stem-base (x=3,y=11.6,w=6,h=8.4,rx=0.8,opacity=1), bowl (x=10.2,y=11.6,w=10.8,h=8.4,rx=0.8,opacity=1). Top brick overhangs to the right; stem-base is narrow; bowl is wide.
logo.mark_rn_proportions: In React Native (absolute-positioned Views): h=7*size, wTop=11*size, wBotL=6*size, wBotR=10*size, rGap=2*size, cGap=max(1,round(size)), borderRadius=1.2*size. Top brick opacity 0.82.
logo.mark_color: brick (#D2542B) for the mark on dark backgrounds
logo.mark_WRONG: Do NOT use equal-width stem bricks — that makes a pyramid. stem-top must be wider than stem-base. stem-base must be narrow (wBotL=6 on 24px viewBox, or 6*size in RN). Do NOT use centered top brick.
logo.wordmark: 'bricks' in GeneralSans-Medium, color moon (#F4F1EB) on dark, fontSize×(-0.035) letter-spacing, gap = fontSize×0.4

rules: Transitions 180ms on color changes, 120ms for press feedback.
No dramatic entrance animations — field use, fast task completion.
Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for body text — dark backgrounds make this easier, but verify moonFaint text.
All actionable elements must have testID (e.g. testID='upload-btn', testID='job-row-08412').
Focus rings: 2px solid moon with 2px offset.

dispatch.theme_default: dark — always. Field legibility at 6am, matte not glossy.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Use General Sans as the display/body font (fontFamily: 'GeneralSans-Medium' or 'GeneralSans-Regular') and JetBrains Mono for all data/numbers (fontFamily: 'JetBrainsMono_400Regular'). Never use System, Helvetica, or platform-conditional fonts.
CRITICAL: Dispatch is ALWAYS dark. Use night (#141210) as primary background, moon (#F4F1EB) as primary text. Never render a light theme.
CRITICAL: The color system is warm night/moon (not pure black/white or zinc). Use the exact hex values in the tokens section.
CRITICAL: Border radius is 2px everywhere (borderRadius: 2). No borderRadius > 2 except chips (borderRadius: 999).
CRITICAL: Zero drop shadows on content. No elevation, no shadowColor on cards or panels.
CRITICAL: This is a React Native / Expo TypeScript project. Write .tsx files with proper TypeScript types. Use StyleSheet.create() for styles.
Overline labels are always: fontFamily mono, ~10px, letterSpacing 0.14–0.18em, textTransform uppercase, color moonMute.
All numeric values — shot counts, prices, times, job IDs — must use JetBrains Mono.
Include testID on all actionable elements and navigation items.
Never use placeholder image URLs. Only use media URLs that are explicitly provided.
